summary_en: Chudenko Corporation's board authorized acquisition of own shares via public tender offer. The company targets capital efficiency improvement and shareholder returns while maintaining DOE (dividend on equity) of around 3.0% and increasing FY2027 annual dividend per share from 140 to 150 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Own Shares and Public Tender Offer for Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Chudenko Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire treasury shares through a public tender offer as a specific implementation method under the Companies Act Article 156(1) and the company's articles of incorporation. The company positions shareholder returns as a key management priority.

The buyback program complements the dividend strategy. The company targets dividend on equity (DOE) of approximately 3.0% and maintains a sustainable, stable dividend policy. For FY2026 (year ending March 2026), annual dividend per share was set at 135 yen (interim 65 yen, final 70 yen). The company revised FY2027 annual dividend upward from the previously announced 140 yen to 150 yen per share (an increase of 10 yen), with the interim dividend at 70 yen and the revised final dividend at 80 yen.

Treasury share acquisitions are undertaken to enhance capital efficiency as a shareholder return strategy, considering business performance, capital position, growth investment opportunities, and market conditions including stock price. The company has a board-authorized buyback framework under the Companies Act Article 165(2), enabling flexible capital policy execution without shareholder approval. Over the past five years, acquisitions have been completed via Tokyo Stock Exchange market purchases: in December 2022 (397,900 shares, 829.6 million yen), November 2023 (606,300 shares, 1.46 billion yen), December 2024 (428,700 shares, 1.41 billion yen), and February 2026 (1,216,400 shares, 6.03 billion yen). The specific acquisition amount, share volume, and period for the current tender offer are not disclosed in the provided documentation.
